messages:
sharon: FYI ran a 100k request perf sweep on canary cluster A->B. p95 is stable but p99 is +120ms vs baseline. Trace points at kernel selector flipping to fused-attn on tiny batches and a KV-prefetch thrash in slab-aligned cohorts. Uploaded traces to the perf bucket: gs://perf/redwood/canary/1778882222/flame.svg

max: what's the batch size / decode-rate distribution for that sweep?

sharon: median prompt_len ~64. About ~30% of traffic falls into a slow-decode-rate bucket (decode-rate < 10 tok/s) so they typically end up in small-batch micropaths. The fused kernel path we enabled for <32 tokens triggers a microbatch split which causes aggressive KV prefetches + evictions. KV eviction rate jumped ~3x in the tail.

liam: could we tune token_budget per cohort to force more coalescing for slow decoders? e.g. bump slow cohort to 96 tokens so they wait for larger batches.

divya: caution — in earlier sims increasing token_budget caused head-of-line blocking for fast decoders. We need a cap on per-cohort hold time.

max: suggested quick config to try on canary-b:

```
batching:
  token_budget_by_cohort:
    slow: 96
    mid: 64
    fast: 32
queue:
  slab_hold_ms: 80
kernels:
  disable_fused_small_batch: true
```

max: idea is: cohort-specific token budgets + a slab synchronizer max-hold to prevent long blocking. Also temporarily disable the fused small-batch kernel so we can isolate KV effects.

sharon: plan sounds good. I'll spin up an A/B canary: canary-a = baseline, canary-b = proposed. Traffic ramp 10% -> 30% -> 100% if p99 improves and no p50/p95 regress.

perf-bot: nightly diff flagged a regression: +18ms p99 on dedicated-rt for rdx-v1 after the kernel patch earlier today (see alert #2341).

canary-bot: deployed config to canary-b at 1778882245 (10% traffic).

liam: can we get KV metrics per-cohort (eviction rate, prefetch hit rate, avg prefetch size)? need to correlate slowpath kernel tags with eviction spikes.

divya: I can add cohort labels to the KV exporter and emit histograms for eviction and prefetch hit. Will push a patch in ~2h and backfill the last 24h.

max: also add a lightweight request tag when the runtime takes the slowpath kernel so we can correlate with prompt_len and decode_rate in tracing.

sharon: nice. once metrics are in we'll run the canary for 30m steady state and check: p50/p95 delta, p99 delta, kv-eviction, prefetch-hit, and kernel-slowpath-rate. If p99 > +50ms after 30m we rollback. :thumbsup:

liam: one more ask — add a small profiler slice on canary-b for microbatch formation so we can see hold times per slab and number of split events.

sharon: agreed. I'll coordinate with infra to enable microbatch sampling at 1% traffic. Ping me when divya's exporter is live.

max: thanks — will monitor metrics and post a short summary after the 30m window.

sharon: thanks everyone. keeping this as the single thread for the rollout and postmortem.
